paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and accuracy for both training and validation datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. A dark blue solid line represents the “Train” dataset, beginning at approximately 48% accuracy at an epoch of 0 and rising to approximately 98% accuracy at an epoch of 30, with fluctuations in between; for example, the line decreases to approximately 42% at epoch 18 before increasing again. A green dashed line represents the “Validation” dataset, starting at approximately 48%  accuracy at an epoch of 0 and increasing to about 83% accuracy at an epoch of 30, exhibiting more frequent fluctuations throughout the plotted range, such as a peak of approximately 68% at epoch 4 and a decline to approximately 40% at epoch 10.
